items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I mean Jean Cooper played there.

ctx.x: And going up against the wall over there. And people standing down at the bar, you were blowing over the heads and people sitting at the tables are back there. But people came in there didn‟t just see the jazz, they would see the kind of musician. I mean Jean Cooper played there.
